research_window.year_model: CE integers; astronomical year numbering for BCE

verification_limitations: Curated first-pass research seed; most records use one institutional regional overview, not two independent specialist assessments. Editorial confidence is not a numerical probability and does not replace further checking. Specific uncertainty is flagged. No politically accurate historical boundary polygons produced.

major_gaps.description: No vetted time-sliced sovereignty polygons. Existing application uses point markers; resist modern-country overlays for early states.
Sparse local-event coverage for many African, Pacific, Australian, Amazonian and North American communities reflects evidence and present research limits, not uninhabited land.

No single pan-Australian society or empire record. Future Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander regional case studies require local archaeology and cultural permissions, and should avoid fixed dates without evidence.
Simultaneous American societies must not be represented as having transcontinental or transoceanic contact absent evidence.
Cite Maya dynastic rivalry with separate city-state records. Further inscriptions should independently verify Tikal, Copan, Quirigua, Calakmul and Palenque chronology.
Evidence for settlement of remote East Polynesia has been extensively revised; 500–1000 CE records should not imply Rapa Nui, Aotearoa or Hawai‘i were already inhabited.
East African coastal settlement and urbanism varies by site; a generic Swahili cultural label is a regional heuristic, not a single polity.
No definitive first-settlement timestamp for Madagascar derived from the few sources reviewed; keep chronology unresolved.
Carolingian successor states and Anglo-Saxon kingdoms need separate time-dependent political entities when detailed maps are added.
Need finer regional evidence for Deccan, Bengal, Kashmir, Himalayan communities and Sri Lanka beyond dynasty overviews.
Very few surviving 500–1000 CE terrestrial world maps. Later manuscript copies must show composition date and physical copy date separately.
Missing links are not evidence technology absent. Verify independent innovations versus adoption, and tie milestones to site-specific archaeology where possible.
Most draft records cite one reliable regional summary; claims need independent, preferably primary or specialised secondary verification before publishing as verified facts.
Do not add point-estimate city populations without specialist datasets, definitions, ranges and reliability.
No remote media included. Check each museum artefact image, manuscript reproduction and Indigenous cultural protocol independently of descriptive metadata licence.
Commoners, agriculture, gender, housing and family topics need specialised archaeological and social-history coverage.
Existing repo uses BCE negative-year shorthand and normalises at runtime. This CE-only dataset has no BCE conversion need; future blocks require an explicit importer conversion.
